title: Weave an Apprentice
description: Ysil's loom hums when you stand near it. She offers to teach you how to weave an apprentice — a little helper that answers when you call.

hudHints.objective: Weave an Apprentice at Ysil's loom
hudHints.instruction:
Find Ysil in the village square and step up to her loom.
You'll make five choices — cloth, name, voice, tools, recipe — and a real skill will walk off the loom into your .claude/skills/ folder.
hudHints.detail: This is the heart of skill authoring in Claude Code: a SKILL.md file with frontmatter (name, description, allowed-tools) and a markdown body. The Loom turns each choice into a field. At the end, the file is written to disk and the Apprentice is yours to summon from any conversation.
hudHints.copyable: Talk to Ysil at the loom in the village square

npcReaction.speaker: Ysil
npcReaction.text: There. The thread holds. Step back — let them stand on their own.

_creatorNote.lesson: Skills are the player's most compound tool. This quest decomposes skill authoring into five choices — archetype, name, description, tools, body — and makes each one a character-creation decision. The trade-offs are made visible: tool budgets by archetype teach scope discipline, the description composer teaches that triggering is the hardest part, and the Summoning Arena gives immediate feedback via precision/recall.
_creatorNote.realWorldParallel: Creating a SKILL.md file in .claude/skills/<name>/ with well-chosen frontmatter and a body the agent can rely on.
